messages:
nina: Quick follow-up from the PG+KV timeout postmortem. We need concrete owners for runbook edits, a short validation plan for scheduler throttling, and a playback exercise. Keep items tiny so they close fast.

pm_renee: please list owners + short ETA so I can update the postmortem follow-ups.

nina: proposed owners:
- DB triage runbook (commands + thresholds) -> rahul (3 business days)
- Pager pre-checks + 5min playback script -> emily (2 business days)
- Job-scheduler throttle validation -> ops_june (7 days)
- Routing fallback tuning note -> nina (1 week)

rahul: i'll add exact SQL and kubectl snippets and make thresholds explicit. PR ETA 72h. Example I'll include:
```
# replication lag (sql)
psql -c "select now() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp() as lag;"
# replication lag (kubectl)
kubectl exec -n infra svc/pg -- psql -c "select now() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp();"
# circuit-breaker status
curl -sS -H \"Authorization: Bearer $RB_TOKEN\" https://ops.internal/api/cb/status?svc=pg | jq '.'
```
Thresholds: >=20s -> start mitigation steps; >=60s -> escalate to infra lead; >=120s -> promote standby.

emily: pager edits: add a pre-alert DM to oncall for 5 minutes that runs exporter health check and a short log dump before paging. Playback script for handoff (5-10min): 1) run replication lag 2) gather `kubectl logs -l app=pg -n infra --tail=250` 3) run `select * from pg_stat_activity limit 10;` 4) practice DM/escalation. PR ETA 48h.

ops_june: I'll run a 72h job-start sample and correlate with write QPS, then propose a safe default throttle (and rollback plan). ETA 7 days. Tentative threshold to validate: delay big jobs when DB QPS > 1800 for 5m.

nina: recurring pattern: 3 similar partial timeouts over 9 weeks during bulk reindexes/bulk imports. Runbook should have a short 'when to throttle' subsection and a scheduler hook example.

rahul: will add the throttle subsection and a one-line tl;dr + dashboard quick-links at the top of the runbook.

emily: will add the DM template and who to cc on escalation (service lead + infra oncall). Also adding a Slack shortcut to run checks.

pm_renee: can owners file GH issues and link them here? I'll mark postmortem as 'followups scheduled' once issues exist. Cadence: ping in this thread every 3 business days.

rahul: created ISSUE-1501 for runbook DB edits -> PR #521 (draft).

emily: created ISSUE-1502 for pager + playback -> PR #522 (ready).

ops_june: created ISSUE-1503 for scheduler validation -> collecting data, findings ETA 7 days.

sre_bot: Follow-up reminder scheduled in 3 business days: 1766266690.

nina: thanks all :thumbsup: small ask 10 add exact cli variants so oncall can run checks from shell or kubectl quickly. Keep PRs focused and link back to postmortem.

rahul: will open PR by EOD Thursday and tag reviewers.

emily: PR will be open by tomorrow morning, tagging oncall and doc owners.

ops_june: sampling started, will post findings and proposed limiter config in ISSUE-1503 comments.

pm_renee: logging this thread into the postmortem followups page. If blocked, escalate here.

nina: closing loop for now; next check-in in 3 business days. If anything blocks earlier, ping me
